notes: Constructor: EHSHook(IPoolManager manager_, address token_). Arg 1 is $poolManager (the launch chain's Uniswap v4 PoolManager; Ethereum mainnet 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90), arg 2 is $token (the EHS token the factory deploys just before the hook). The paired currency IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 is a compile-time constant. No owner, factory, treasury or other address is taken; nothing is settable after deployment and there is no proxy or upgrade. Permissions: getHookPermissions enables beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta, so the hook must sit at a CREATE2-mined address whose low 14 bits are 0x20cc (bits 13, 7, 6, 3, 2); the constructor validates them. Every callback and unlockCallback refuse any caller but the PoolManager. beforeInitialize accepts only the pool of $token and IMD at static LP fee 12500 (1.25%) with tick spacing 60 and this hook, at any opening price; the dynamic-fee flag is never used and the LP fee is never overridden. Fees: on top of the 1.25% LP fee the hook takes 2% of the IMD that actually filled on every swap, via return deltas, and holds it as its own ERC-6909 IMD claims in the PoolManager (never transferred out inside a swap, so a manager holding no IMD cannot make a swap revert). When IMD is the unspecified side the 2% is taken in afterSwap from the real BalanceDelta. When IMD is the specified side beforeSwap reserves ceil(amount/51) on exact input or ceil(amount/49) on exact output, capped for huge price-limited requests, and afterSwap reconciles against the real fill, minting the excess as an ERC-6909 IMD claim to the swap sender (the router), which must pass it on to its payer. A swap whose amount plus reserve would overflow int256 reverts with UnrepresentableFee; no other swap is ever reverted. Buyer rewards: a buy (IMD in) that fills at least 10 IMD records 1% of the filled IMD for the recipient the router names by passing abi.encode(recipient) as hookData, capped by accrued fees not already owed; empty or malformed hookData records nothing and never blocks the swap, and the router itself is never credited. pending(address) and owedTotal() are views. claimRewards() pays msg.sender; payRecorded(address) lets anyone pay a recorded reward to its own beneficiary only. Payment unlocks the PoolManager, burns the claim and takes IMD to the beneficiary, never inside a swap callback. Accrued fees not recorded as rewards have no recipient and remain in the hook. Supply: EHS mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens (1e27 units) to its deployer, the launch factory, which seeds the pool and distributes the swarm share; no contract here allocates supply. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the factory sets the opening price.
